_about: Who may read each web source (tests/test_loaders_are_gated.py). gate: p2 = the offices that open P2; p0 = any signed-in roster person; admin = an administrator as themselves; p2+admin = either; open = no sign-in (public or owner-view by design). A loader not listed fails the test: gate it in jason.web.gates (or in the loader) or classify it here with a reason.
